note:
PI-RADS v2.1: how a multiparametric prostate MRI is reported and scored. A web capture, small and cleanly structured.

It earns its place the way the ASPEN screening tool does: the corpus can say what a PI-RADS category *means* and what should follow from it, while the score itself arrives in the dossier already assigned by the radiologist. The corpus is not being asked to compute it.

default.note: Detection and local staging of prostate cancer by MRI. Non-metastatic by construction -- this is the scan that finds the tumour in the gland -- and the risk group is not something an MRI report assigns. Serves diagnosis, staging throughout: Every passage is about acquiring, reporting and scoring a prostate MRI: finding the tumour and saying where it sits in the gland.
